subject: Request: Approve case study + concessional credit for Finovate App
messages:
From: Elena Soto <esoto@finovate.app>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lee <mlee@finovate.app>
Date: Wed, 30 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Draft case study and request around commercial credit

Hi Jonas,

Thanks again for last week's demo — the team is excited by what Redwood can do for our latency-sensitive pipelines. Marcus and I reviewed the draft case study you sent (see attached) and we're happy to proceed, but we had two quick asks:

- Could Redwood redact the internal numbers on page 2 (we'll provide a redacted version).
- We're asking for a 12% credit on the first quarter's invoice in exchange for the case study and logo use in Redwood marketing (website + blog).

Are those asks something you can confirm quickly? Marcus mentioned the SOW is otherwise ready to sign.

Best,
Elena Soto
Head of Platform, Finovate App

Attachments: finovate_case_study_comments.pdf (pdf)

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Sep 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Draft case study and request around commercial credit

Stephanie / Avery — forwarding Elena's note from Finovate. They're willing to go public with a case study + logo, but are asking for a 12% credit on Q1 in exchange for marketing rights and allowing us to quote them. SOW otherwise signed.

Quick facts:
- Contract value (year 1): $420k ARR (metered usage + dedicated buffer)
- Requested credit: 12% of Q1 invoice (~$12,600 estimated)
- Marketing benefit: homepage logo, blog feature + short webinar co-hosted Q4
- Legal: Marketing/Brand to review redaction request; Marketing prefers a 15% concession if we want exclusive timed placement on homepage for 60 days.

Can we get sign-off to offer the 12% credit (or 15% if we want elevated placement)? Need an authorized exception because this is outside standard deal desk threshold.

Jonas
Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Attachments: finovate_draft_case_study_v1.docx

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Sep 2026 12:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Draft case study and request around commercial credit

Jonas — thanks for flagging. A few items from Ops/Marketing:

- Marketing is okay with logo + blog + webinar given brand guidelines are followed; they want the right to approve the final creative and to ensure the redactions are applied.
- Legal has requested a non-exclusive publicity release (no press embargo) with standard indemnities — they can turn the clause in 48 hours.
- Finance: 12% credit for Q1 is under the threshold for Director approval, but since this ties to marketing exposure, I'd like to escalate to Vivek for a decision on whether we give the 12% standard credit or stretch to 15% for the homepage package.

Avery, can you confirm impact to quarterly bookings if we approve 12% vs 15%? I want a quick dollar figure to present.

-Stephanie
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Sep 2026 14:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Draft case study and request around commercial credit

Thanks for the context. Approve the concession with conditions:

1) Approve up to 12% credit on Q1 invoice, capped to the first invoice only (no carry-forward).
2) If Marketing wants the 60-day homepage placement, approve up to 15% but require Marketing to sign off on the final creative and the exact placement window (i.e., measurement of views/clicks).
3) Require a short-term exclusivity clause limited to not working with direct competitor AcmeFin on their core payments feature for 90 days (Marketing to draft language).
4) Finance to mark the deal as "marketing-backed concession" in the CRM and record the net retained ARR impact in the forecast.

Jonas — you can communicate the 12% approval to Elena immediately and offer the 15% upgrade subject to Marketing + Legal sign-off; Finance will need the final SOW to apply the credit.

-Vivek
VP Sales, Redwood Inference

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Elena Soto <esoto@finovate.app>
Cc: Marcus Lee <mlee@finovate.app>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 01 Oct 2026 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Draft case study and request around commercial credit

Elena — thanks for the note and the quick turnaround on the redaction file. Good news: leadership has approved a 12% credit on the first invoice in exchange for the case study + logo permissions.

A couple of optional items: if you want premium placement (60-day homepage feature) we can increase the credit to 15% pending final Marketing & Legal sign-off and agreement on a short exclusivity window (90 days, limited to direct payments competitors).

Next steps:
- I'll send an updated SOW that includes the 12% invoice credit.
- Marketing will review the redacted draft and move the case study to final copy.
- Legal will send the publicity release for signatures (48 hours).
- We can schedule the co-hosted webinar for late-November if you confirm availability.

Appreciate the collaboration — excited to make this live.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Phone: (415) 555-0198
